name: Closing CTA band
definition: Full-width, high-contrast band near the end of a page that restates the promise with one primary and one secondary action.
bestUse: The last section before the footer, for visitors who read to the end.

demo.how: Visitors who reach the end are ready to decide, so the page repeats its promise in one band with a clear primary action and a lower-commitment secondary one. Play shows the band, the headline, then the two buttons. The copy is illustrative.
